heard: Eliashib, the high priest, began Rebuilding the sheep gate again They consecrated it with care Set doors and bolted them there Next to them, Marimoth worked on repairs For the city strong, Mishulam, son of Bereshia Made repairs as the wall grew Zadok, son of Banna, joined Next to them, their labor joined Men of Tekor made repairs But nobles would not lift their care On the twenty-fifth hour
